generation.scope: The degree-four del Pezzo surface image cannot occur on the regular-domain finite main component. Its conic-bundle center has Brauer index at most two for all binary leading forms. A basepoint on a birational smooth-quadric threefold image is also impossible for every pole divisor, including nonnormal and reducible quadrics. Only singular quadric threefolds and cubic scroll images remain as basepoint candidates.

open_mathematics: Analyze the remaining singular quadric centers and scroll covers by their Brauer ramification, while testing residual regularity beyond the domain locus.
